acceptanceCriteria: Each test is reproduced or ruled out on clean origin/main under GOMAXPROCS=3 -p 1, and under load, with logs retained.
A confirmed product defect is fixed in internal/tasks with a maintained regression test; a confirmed load-only failure is folded into the test reliability umbrella with its threshold recorded.
The cli package passes both tests under the umbrella's load condition, or each remaining failure is a stated, ticketed limit.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator from the V1-0964 lane (suspected; not yet triaged).

Observed: in a whole-package run of internal/tasks/cli at base 0b5096ca (worktree detached at that commit, Go 1.27.1, Darwin 25.6.0, host load about 54-63 on 12 CPUs), TestPSRDispatchNativeAdapter and TestPSRForegroundSignals failed. TestPSRForegroundSignals reported "sweep git: bounded observation failed". The same failures appeared on the V1-0964 branch, so they predate it. TestPSRV0013 and TestPSRV0015 also failed once but passed on rerun. No existing ticket names either test.

Expected: both pass at base. Actual: both fail at base under load. Unknown: whether they fail on a quiet host (possible duplicate of the test reliability umbrella). Lane log: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-russelllewis-projects-corvint/6233e93d-5d48-4a72-b44f-5d97acbb51d3/tasks/b2n4xn6gc.output.
title: tests (suspected): TestPSRDispatchNativeAdapter and TestPSRForegroundSignals fail at base 0b5096ca under load (sweep git: bounded observation failed)
